newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends softer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends softer in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed softer on Thursday in quiet trade following late demand for U.S. dollars, and dealers expected a stable rate to continue.
The local unit finished at T$27.498 against Wednesday's T$27.495 close. Turnover through dealers was US$152 million.

The local dollar strengthened slightly in morning trade, mainly to reflect the weak U.S. dollar in overseas markets. But late U.S dollar demand pulled the local unit down, dealers said. "There is not much going on in the foreign exchange market and the rate will just stay stable," said one dealer. A T$27.49-27.50 range was seen for Friday. -Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
